observations.summary: Workforce Center @ Mesa lists professional clothing boutique for job seekers at 635 E Broadway Rd Mesa AZ 85204; no Mesa residency requirement. Listed populations include adults 18+, citizens or noncitizens authorized to work, veterans with priority, people with disabilities and housing insecurity. Center contact Lorraine Alvarez 480-594-2501 or LaTonya Eaton 480-572-1429; center hours Mon/Tue/Thu/Fri 8:30am–2:30pm, Wednesday appointment only. These are center hours, not confirmed boutique hours. Linked interest form is for employers, not clothing recipients. City partnership includes A New Leaf and Arizona at Work; separate from excluded Smart Justice service.
questions: Can a job seeker get interview clothes without enrolling in another program, and when is the boutique open? The city lists the boutique but only center-wide hours.

observations.summary: DES Cash Assistance eligibility and required-document search examined a benefits pathway. Eligibility depends on family and financial circumstances; application requires a mandatory interview and supporting verification. No reviewed source established a clothing-specific benefit or immediate clothing referral, so retain as research gap, not a written clothing lead.
questions: Is there an explicit current DES clothing-support pathway serving Mesa, with an intake route?
